title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order — part 6/8 (Sections 12–15)
main_claim: Sections 12–15 do three things. First, they turn deep discrepancy into tail and moment bounds for "interactions" (centered products). Second, they extract disjoint host patches and allocate the cube to them by dyadic prefixes, then clean the first supports. Third, they build the internal slice solver and use a Kakutani fixed point to choose balanced patch profiles. With these they embed the cube in the high direct mode and in both high cluster modes (small-bin and large-bin) via mass gates, column-load moments and Hall's theorem.
coverage:
I audited all of Sections 12, 13, 14 and 15 line by line. Cited statements I read to check hypotheses: Cor initial-discrepancy (eq source-2), Prop full-dimensional-cluster-exclusion with Cor eventual-cluster-absence, Cor remaining-deep-regime, the projection/list construction in Sec 10, and the regime guide. Statements I took as black boxes, checking hypotheses only and not re-proving them: the clock lemma, Lemma scattered-moments, Lemma conditional-avoidance, Lemma gated-posterior, Lemma height-selection, eq source-4, and eq source-17 / Lemma near-product-injection.

Section 12:
- Cor deep-discrepancy: verified as a restatement of Cor remaining-deep-regime.
- Lemma heterogeneous-centered-moment: verified. The alternating-sum expansion is correct and singleton interactions vanish.
- Lemma deep-interaction-tails: verified.
  - One-free bound: the conditioned width n^{x*/4}+αn/3 is below αn.
  - Two-free bound: t=n^{.25}. E||S||^2=O(t+t^2 b*^2). The Fubini step is valid because norm-goodness of the tuple does not depend on x. The contradiction holds because n^{-.835} < n^{-.78}.
  - Mean bound: .96/2 > .4.
- Lemma moderate-interaction-moment: verified.
  - Tail ranges: exp(2^u n^{.06} − n^{.4}) and exp(2^{u+1}ξn − αn/3), using ξ < α2^{-10u-100}.
  - The coefficient Σ_{I⊇S}(−1)^{u−|I|} vanishes unless S=[u].
  - Terms with more than L interactions contribute at most (2^u n^{-.03})^{L+1} ≤ n^{-15R}.
  - Terms with at most L interactions give n^{L−.4u/L} ≤ n^{−3L}, since u > 10L².
- Lemma homogeneous-peeling: verified. Average-vector projection bound 1/t+3θ; the Ramsey binomial bound; maximal-retained-set peeling with cost D^{-d} per deleted coordinate; Markov on the even centered moment.
- Lemma simultaneous-row-trimming: verified, including the mesh interpolation: |K_π−K_π'| ≤ ||π−π'||_1, the threshold containments, and the weight factor e^{100n^{-2}}.

Section 13:
- Lemma residual-scale-bounds: verified.
  - g ≤ n^{ι/2}.
  - For q: red codegree = (1+m+m'+K)/4. The widths (≤ n^{γ'a_C} < n^δ < n^{η_0}), the atom cap e^{-q} ≤ exp(−n^ζ) and the codegree surplus θ/8 > n^{-δ} all meet the hypotheses of Prop full-dimensional-cluster-exclusion.
- Prop patch-extraction-allocation: verified.
  - The top-eighth argument: 1/8(1/2+2g/n) + 7/8(1/2+g/(2n)) = 1/2+11g/(16n) < 1/2+g/n.
  - Cluster extraction, and k_iT_i ≪ q^{a_C/2}, log d_i.
  - The h_i ranges in low and high mode.
  - Exact dyadic summation to 1, and Σ_J M_i > S/2.
  - ℓ_i ≤ log2(S/M_i)+1, max(h_i, ℓ_i) < n^ι, and ℓ_i, log(N/M_i) ≤ s_i/(1000u).
- Lemma stable-patch-cleaning: verified.
  - The approximant construction t = Ne^{-(B+W)/2}.
  - Own-degree rectangles at an absent dyadic budget, with C_b·a_B > 100·a_C.
  - Clique exclusion at Q_i ∈ [q², 2q²] (cluster) or ~g/√M_1 (direct), including Δ_i ≤ e^{s_i}, which uses 2C_*/√M_1 < 10^{-3}.
  - Other-patch degrees and row tails.
  - The codegree retention (1/4+3a−r)/(1−r) ≥ 1/4+a for r < a.
  - The mesh margins.

Section 14:
- Prop internal-slice-solver: verified.
  - Syndrome projection ψ: fibers of size h, multiplicities ≥ 2.
  - Mask bounds: the masked bin prior is ≤ 2d/M, and the aggregate is ≤ 4/M.
  - The clipped-log mean: the two-point extreme gives −log4+1.85a ≥ −log4+.7a.
  - The search union bound exp(h(O(T log h) − Ω(a²k))).
  - (13): the caps on q, p and the in-bin support size.
  - Likelihood ratio 2e^{(log2−.08a)k j_g − .24ak}.
  - Posterior cap e^{(log2−.04a)kh}; B-set bound exp(−.013akh).
  - σ_v cap 2^h e^{-500 s_i}, since .02a > .0005a.
  - Markov plus the union bound for (15).
- Low-mode pretrim and the TV bound: verified.
- Prop balanced-patch-profiles: verified. Continuity through the barycentric weights; the outputs land in the capped domain; the Kakutani fixed point gives max π_i ≤ 11/M_i.
- Lemma finite-low-mode-data: verified.

Section 15:
- Lemma high-direct-assignment: verified. Γ ≤ e^{s_i+O(ℓ)+g^{a_B}−.4g} ≤ e^{-200 s_i}; the peeling term is ≤ n^{-.2K_B}; column sums O(A_x/C_n), with union bound N(K/C_n)^n → 0.
- Cluster alarms: verified.
  - Product-of-degrees test: Hoeffding with range b*, plus an O(n b*²) log correction.
  - T_v raw mean: Γ ≤ e^{-450 s_i}; the nominal-versus-conditional split uses linearity of E_W p^W = π_i; the gated one-free bound is fine.
  - LLL charges, using the volume bound e^{s/1000}.
- Lemma high-cluster-mass: verified. 5^{u(ℓ+1)}2^u e^{-100s} ≤ n^{-3R}.
- Prop high-cluster-sampling: verified. Bucket certificates: l_j−1 ≥ 20z gives (e/10)^{l−1} decay; total allowed load ≤ θ_0. Small-bin atoms ≤ d^{-.95}, and h = o(d^{.025}).
- Prop high-cluster-loads: verified. Cap in (20); core-near fraction 2^{-n}e^{.01s}; small-bin repeat cost d/M_i ≤ 2^{-n}e^{o(s)}; crossing repeats 2^{-n+o(n)}, using d_j ≤ e^{n^γ/2}; forest/rank cost.
sibling_notes:
The block depends on several black-box tools from other parts, and their parameter ranges should be checked by the reviewers of those sections:
- Lemma height-selection: the e^{-h^{Ω(1)}} bound at higher levels and the O(1/λ) bound at level zero, both uniform in eligibility. These feed (14).
- Lemma gated-posterior: failure e^{-.01akh}.
- eq (17) / Lemma near-product-injection: joint error exp(d^{-.04} h), with maximum atom d^{-.95}.
- Lemma scattered-moments and the clock lemma with B=5.
- Lemma conditional-avoidance: the charge-inflation form used for the bin certificates.

Low direct mode, the bounded case and low cluster mode are used here but finished in Sections 16–18.
